notes.title: Happy holiday! The new version is updated now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I wish you a happy holiday, and the new version is update now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/b0797811ef4a64bd1aaf9731f4359c5532486584.png[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: Controller support has been fixed!
Problem about controller support
notes.notes: We found that the controller support had some problem, which in some cases resulted in the character being unable to operate, and the effect was not permanent. At present, if you need to use the gamepad, please plug it in before starting the game to avoid mixing with the keyboard and pulling out the gamepad during the game. We will fix this problem as soon as possible. We are very sorry.

notes.title: Fury Fight Is Coming On April 13, 2022(PT)
notes.notes:
We're beyond excited to announce that [i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i], our retro arcade action game, is coming to Steam! Whether you are an arcade gamer or just new to this type of game, we hope you have a wonderful time while playing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/cd603fc89255bea6994d95a5037567c56606996d.png[/img]

[h1]About [i]Fury Fight[/i][/h1]
        [b][i]Fury Fight[/i][/b] is a new IP but classic action game, whice is committed to reproduce the arcade game experience, action performance and coherent skill combo, while requiring players not low reaction speed. You can incarnate 3 protagonists with different fighting styles (ALL CAN RUN) : the powerful Sheriff Hawk Eye, the agile basketball boy Arado, and the lithe double form agent Red Sheep, fighting against the evil organization "SCHOOL" in the imaginary cyberpunk world. This journey will be full of difficulties, in the face of difficult teammate, once partner, hunting across the parallel world...What will be the fate of the heroes?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1496150/_/

[h1]Development History[/h1]
[i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i] was first established in mid-2019, with most of the team being new to the game and learning to make it as they went along, making it "a young person's first game". By early 2020, when Fury Fight had a basic structure, we thought it would be fun if players could manipulate enemy characters to fight, so we started working on a combat game called [i][b]Rupture Void[/b][/i].What's interesting is that many people know of [i][b]Rupture Void[/b][/i] before hear of [i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i].
Then, from the second half of 2020, COVID-19 and the market environment brought about the winter of games, which also made our team encounter difficulties. Therefore, we needed to spend a lot of time to complete some outsourcing projects, so that our team could survive.Unfortunately, [i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i] was shelved.
Until the end of 2021, after we take a breath, we immediately start to optimize the experience, hoping to give you a complete and indelible experience. In the process, player's enthusiasm and expectation from QQ group, suggestions and feedback on the Youtube, let us have sufficient confidence and power to deal with every difficulties! Thank you! Without you, we could not make [i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i] launch on April 14th!


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
After launch, we will continue to work on improvements and new content, including optimizing operation, improving performance, and localizing more languages. We also look forward to your suggestions on how we can make the games better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/3e7e9477a7c47d390b67b722a60d900e4cd546a7.png[/img]

[h1]Thank You!![/h1]
It was the support and feedback that motivated our team to make [i][b]Fury Fight[/b][/i] release. Thank you, thank you to all the players, thank you to everyone who worked on it, thank you!!

[h1]Make a Friend!![/h1]
If you like our game, or are interested in indie games, welcome to our QQ group: 604384699, play games together, share feelings to everyone~
